lines.text: Tap a bowl with one fingertip, then lift to let it ring.
Circle the outside of the rim, slowly, to sing.
Slower, and press a little. Let it build.
A little faster: about one slow circle a second.
Rub the outside of the rim, not the inside.
You can also circle on top of the rim.
Rest your palm on a bowl to quiet it.
Strike gently with your palm for a deep, soft ring.
Tap first, then circle: it sings sooner.
Or pinch the stick and circle the rim with it.
Tap with the soft end. Open your hand to set it down.
The singing bowls are by your left knee.
Tap each bowl as its block lands.
Circle the rim until the block sinks in.
